data: Microsoft reported diluted earnings per share of $9.68 for fiscal 2023, which ended June 30, 2023, compared with $9.65 for fiscal 2022. That is an increase of about 0.3%, so EPS was essentially flat year over year. Net income for fiscal 2023 was $72.4 billion ($72,361 million), down roughly 1% from $72.7 billion in fiscal 2022. EPS still edged up despite the lower net income because share repurchases reduced the diluted share count.
